newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Greens criticise ERA plan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Greens criticise ERA plan.

text.p: The Australian Greens said on Friday the upcoming release of Energy Resources of Australia Ltd's environmental impact plan for its Jabiluka uranium mine showed Environment Minister Robert Hill was irrelevant.
"Senator Hill has become incidental. The mining giant is running his agenda," Greens senator Bob Brown said in a statement.
Earlier on Friday, ERA said it planned to release a draft environmental impact study for the Northern Territory mine on October 17.
The plan examined a number of options for development of the Jabiluka Number Two deposit, which contains 90,400 tonnes of uranium oxide, ERA said.
Environmentalists previously have criticised ERA's plans to mine the orebody because it borders the Kakadu National Park.
But ERA said under the proposal, the mine site would disturb less than 20 hectares of land.
"It (the area) is just magnificent and to say that it will only take up 20 hectares is like saying a scratch won't matter on a Beethoven record," Brown told reporters.
ERA is 68.4 percent owned by Australian mining and forestry group North Ltd.
